title: Unique Underground Irish Potato Gratin
description: A romantic Irish dish featuring sweet and aerated potatoes, ghee, and a hot stone plate, perfect for a special occasion. This Mediterranean-friendly recipe is sure to impress.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the sliced potatoes and ice water to cover, then let it sit for 30 minutes.
Drain the potatoes and immediately submerge them in an ice bath to stop the cooking process.
In a small saucepan, melt the ghee over medium heat and add the minced garlic, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the heavy cream, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chopped rosemary and shaved parmesan cheese to the cream mixture and stir to combine.
In a hot stone plate, create a layer of potatoes, followed by a spoonful of the garlic ghee and a sprinkle of the cream mixture.
Repeat the layering process until all the ingredients are used, finishing with a layer of cream on top.
Bake the gratin in the preheated oven for 45 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the potatoes are tender.
